entries.original: An Anthropic subscription account blocked by an authentication error recovers on its own when its saved refresh token is still accepted, instead of every request failing with "blocked until re-login". ([senpi#2926](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2926))
entries.translated: An Anthropic subscription account blocked by an authentication error recovers on its own when its saved refresh token is still accepted, instead of every request failing with "blocked until re-login". ([senpi#2926](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2926))

entries.original: A long, tool-heavy turn on a small context window, such as Claude Haiku 5.5's 100K, no longer ends with "compaction did not complete": the earlier steps of the turn are summarized and the latest one is kept. ([senpi#2925](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2925))
entries.translated: A long, tool-heavy turn on a small context window, such as Claude Haiku 5.5's 100K, no longer ends with "compaction did not complete": the earlier steps of the turn are summarized and the latest one is kept. ([senpi#2925](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2925))

entries.original: The reasoning effort you pick for Claude Opus 5 / 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Fable 5.1 now reaches Anthropic; it was always sent as `high`. ([senpi#2912](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2912))
entries.translated: The reasoning effort you pick for Claude Opus 5 / 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Fable 5.1 now reaches Anthropic; it was always sent as `high`. ([senpi#2912](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2912))

entries.original: A model picked in the terminal applies to that session only instead of silently changing the default; press Ctrl+S in the picker or type `/model <id> --default` to make it the default. ([senpi#2870](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2870))
entries.translated: A model picked in the terminal applies to that session only instead of silently changing the default; press Ctrl+S in the picker or type `/model <id> --default` to make it the default. ([senpi#2870](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2870))

entries.original: A fallback model whose context window cannot hold the session no longer ends the fallback; the next model in the chain is tried. ([senpi#2894](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2894))
entries.translated: A fallback model whose context window cannot hold the session no longer ends the fallback; the next model in the chain is tried. ([senpi#2894](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2894))

entries.original: `senpi --list-models`, `--version`, `--help` and `--export` no longer lose output when their stdout is a slowly read pipe. omo's own model probe was hit by this (fewer models listed than exist). ([senpi#2937](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2937), [senpi#2939](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/pull/2939))
entries.translated: `senpi --list-models`, `--version`, `--help` and `--export` no longer lose output when their stdout is a slowly read pipe. omo's own model probe was hit by this (fewer models listed than exist). ([senpi#2937](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2937), [senpi#2939](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/pull/2939))

entries.original: An `ask_user_question` answer is no longer put inside the tool result, where models that treat tool results as untrusted (Claude Haiku 5.5) may ignore it; the answer reaches the model as your own message. ([senpi#2920](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2920))
entries.translated: An `ask_user_question` answer is no longer put inside the tool result, where models that treat tool results as untrusted (Claude Haiku 5.5) may ignore it; the answer reaches the model as your own message. ([senpi#2920](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2920))

entries.original: Children that senpi starts from a script no longer re-run a caller that embeds senpi from `node -e` or `bun -e`. Thanks to @MoerAI. ([senpi#2599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2599), [senpi#2950](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/pull/2950))
entries.translated: Children that senpi starts from a script no longer re-run a caller that embeds senpi from `node -e` or `bun -e`. Thanks to @MoerAI. ([senpi#2599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2599), [senpi#2950](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/pull/2950))

entries.original: Kimi K3 cache writes on Moonshot's API and in the Kimi Coding estimate are priced at the official $3 per million tokens; they were counted as free. ([senpi#2954](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/pull/2954))
entries.translated: Kimi K3 cache writes on Moonshot's API and in the Kimi Coding estimate are priced at the official $3 per million tokens; they were counted as free. ([senpi#2954](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/pull/2954))

entries.original: A config hot reload no longer loops on omo's `omo.jsonc`. ([senpi#2878](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2878))
entries.translated: A config hot reload no longer loops on omo's `omo.jsonc`. ([senpi#2878](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2878))
